mergedParams.userDescription: A single, static word, appearing with a sharp cut on a downbeat. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Sharp Cut Static Word - Downbeat Typography

prompts.prompt: Create a sharp-cut single word typokinetic preset that appears instantly on a musical downbeat, mimicking how a video editor would use a hard cut at a critical moment. The word should slam into frame with maximum impact - think of it as a visual percussion hit. Use a TextAtom with immediate opacity (0 to 1) at the exact start time, no fade-in. The typography should feel heavy and authoritative, using a bold sans-serif font. Add a subtle scale overshoot effect (1.2 to 1.0) over 100-200ms using spring easing to give it a punchy, kinetic feel - like the word is hitting an invisible wall. Position it center-screen with strong presence. Consider adding a very brief (50ms) white flash overlay that appears and fades immediately on impact to emphasize the cut point, similar to how editors add flash frames at beat drops.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center' for centered positioning. Use TextAtom with font 'Inter:900:normal' or similar heavy weight. Implement two-part effect: 1) Instant opacity change at start (no transition), 2) Scale effect using generic keyframe animation with spring easing from scale:1.2 to scale:1.0 over 0.2s. Add a second BaseLayout overlay with 'absolute inset-0 bg-white pointer-events-none' that uses opacity effect from 0.8 to 0 over 0.05s for the flash impact. Set component duration to match the word display time. Use transform-gpu and will-change-transform for performance. Consider adding a subtle text-shadow for depth: 'drop-shadow-2xl'. The instant appearance should feel like a match cut in video editing.

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-style typokinetic preset where a single word appears with digital distortion on the downbeat, as if the video signal is disrupted by the bass hit. Think of this like applying a displacement map effect in After Effects at the exact moment of impact. The word should appear with chromatic aberration - split into RGB channels that converge together over 150ms. Add horizontal scan lines and brief opacity flickers in the first few frames to simulate analog video interference. The text should have a slight horizontal jitter (translateX oscillation) that dampens quickly. This mimics how editors use glitch plugins to emphasize beat drops in music videos. The overall effect should feel like the word is breaking through digital noise to establish itself.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create three overlapping TextAtom components for RGB channel separation, each with 'absolute' positioning and mix-blend-mode. Red channel: 'text-red-500' with translateX:-2px, Green: 'text-green-500' with translateX:0, Blue: 'text-blue-500' with translateX:2px. Animate all three to converge at translateX:0 over 0.15s using ease-out. Add a fourth TextAtom as the main text that fades in slightly delayed (0.05s). Overlay scan lines using repeating BaseLayout divs with 'h-px bg-black/10' spaced with gap-1. Apply opacity flicker effect: [0, 1, 0.3, 1, 0.7, 1] over first 0.1s. Add translateX jitter effect with values: [0, -3, 2, -1, 0] over 0.2s with linear interpolation. Use 'font-mono' for digital aesthetic. Container should have 'relative overflow-hidden' to contain the effects.

prompts.prompt: Build a kinetic typography preset that treats the word like a physical object with mass and momentum. When it appears on the downbeat, it should feel like it's been thrown into frame from above, landing with weight and bounce. Use video editing principles of anticipation and follow-through - the word overshoots its final position, bounces back slightly, then settles. Add a subtle rotation wobble as it lands, like a coin settling on a table. Include a brief shadow that expands outward on impact, then contracts, giving the impression of the word compressing the space beneath it. This mimics how motion designers use Newton physics plugins to create realistic motion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing TextAtom positioned with 'absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2'. Initial translateY: -100vh (off-screen), animate to translateY: 10% (overshoot), then to translateY: 0 with bounce easing over 0.4s total. Add rotation effect: [0deg, -3deg, 2deg, -1deg, 0deg] over same duration. Create shadow using separate BaseLayout div with 'absolute -bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 h-4 w-32 bg-black/20 blur-xl'. Animate shadow scaleX: [0.5, 1.5, 1] and opacity: [0, 0.5, 0.3] synchronized with landing. Use 'transform-gpu will-change-transform' for smooth animation. Font should be bold ('font-black text-6xl'). Consider adding subtle scaleY compression: [1, 0.95, 1.02, 1] at impact moment.

prompts.prompt: Create a stencil-reveal typokinetic where the word appears as if spray-painted through a stencil on the downbeat. The effect should mimic how graffiti artists work - quick, aggressive, with slight overspray. Start with a rapid opacity fade-in (0 to 1) over just 50ms, but add texture through a grainy/noisy overlay that suggests spray paint particles. Include subtle color variations across the letters using gradients to simulate uneven paint coverage. Add a very slight blur-to-sharp focus pull (2px to 0) to suggest the paint settling. The edges should have a rough, slightly expanded look. Think of this as recreating a practical effect you might film with high-speed cameras.
prompts.technicalSpecs: TextAtom with 'font-black uppercase' styling, wrapped in BaseLayout with filter effects. Apply CSS filter for initial state: 'blur(2px) contrast(0.8)' transitioning to 'blur(0px) contrast(1)' over 0.1s. Use background-clip:text with gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-current via-current to-black/80 bg-clip-text'. Add noise texture overlay using pseudo-element or additional div with 'mix-blend-mode:multiply opacity-20' and a noise PNG/SVG pattern. Implement paint spray effect using multiple small divs with 'absolute rounded-full bg-current' positioned randomly around text edges, each with staggered opacity animation (0 to 0.3 to 0) over 0.2s. Use filter:url(#roughPaper) with SVG filter for edge roughness if available. Add subtle drop-shadow for depth. Consider scale animation from 0.95 to 1.0 for expansion feel.

prompts.prompt: Design a voltage/electric surge preset where the word appears with an electrical crackling effect on the downbeat. Think of it like a neon sign suddenly getting power - initial flicker, voltage surge, then stabilization. The word should flicker rapidly (3-4 times) in the first 100ms with varying intensities, then hold steady with a subtle electric glow. Add occasional micro-flickers throughout its duration to maintain the unstable electrical feel. Include a bright outline that pulses once on initial impact, then maintains a steady glow. This recreates the practical effect of filming real neon or LED signs powering on.
prompts.technicalSpecs: TextAtom with animated text-shadow for glow effect. Initial flicker pattern using opacity: [0, 1, 0.3, 1, 0.6, 1] over 0.1s with step timing. Primary glow using text-shadow: '0 0 10px currentColor, 0 0 20px currentColor, 0 0 30px currentColor'. Pulse effect on impact: animate text-shadow blur radius from 30px to 10px over 0.2s. Add subtle brightness filter oscillation: [1, 1.1, 1] repeating every 0.5s for electric instability. Use 'font-bold tracking-wider' for display font feel. Container gets 'bg-black' for contrast. Add border outline using separate div with 'absolute inset-0 border-2 border-current' with matching flicker pattern but slight delay (10ms). Consider adding WebKit text-stroke for additional outline: '-webkit-text-stroke: 1px currentColor'.

prompts.prompt: Build a shatter-reform preset where the word appears fragmented on the downbeat, then quickly assembles itself. Like reverse-playing a glass breaking effect in video editing. Each letter starts slightly separated and rotated randomly, then snaps into perfect alignment over 200ms. Add particle effects - small fragments that fly outward and fade as the word forms. Include a brief camera shake effect on the container to emphasize the impact of reformation. This technique is similar to how editors use particle systems and displacement effects to create dynamic text reveals.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create individual TextAtom for each letter using word.split(''), each wrapped in BaseLayout with 'inline-block' positioning. Initial random transforms per letter: translateX(${-10+Math.random()*20}px) translateY(${-10+Math.random()*20}px) rotate(${-15+Math.random()*30}deg), animating to translate(0) rotate(0) over 0.2s with ease-out. Container uses 'flex items-center justify-center' with slight shake: translateX animation [0, -2, 3, -1, 0] over 0.15s. Particle fragments using 5-10 small divs with 'absolute w-1 h-1 bg-current' starting at text position, animating outward with physics-based trajectory (translateX/Y with ease-in) while fading opacity 1 to 0 over 0.3s. Use staggered timing (delay: index * 0.02s) for sequential assembly feel. Apply 'transform-gpu' to all animated elements.

prompts.prompt: Create a stamp/impact preset that simulates a rubber stamp hitting paper on the downbeat. The word appears with immediate full opacity but with a physical deformation effect - starting slightly compressed (scaleY: 0.8) and stretched horizontally (scaleX: 1.1), then bouncing back to normal proportions. Add a brief ink splatter effect around the edges using small dots that appear and fade quickly. Include a subtle paper texture depression effect - a shadow that appears beneath the text as if the stamp pressed into the surface. This mimics practical stamp effects filmed in macro.
prompts.technicalSpecs: TextAtom with initial transform: 'scale(1.1, 0.8)' animating to 'scale(1, 1)' over 0.15s with spring easing. Use 'font-black uppercase tracking-widest' for stamp-like appearance. Ink splatter using 8-12 absolutely positioned divs with 'rounded-full bg-current' of varying sizes (w-0.5 to w-2), placed randomly within 20px radius of text bounds. Each splatter dot animates opacity from 0 to 0.6 to 0 with different delays (0 to 0.1s). Paper depression shadow using BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 -z-10' containing blurred shadow div that animates scaleY from 0 to 1 and opacity from 0 to 0.3. Add subtle textured overlay using CSS filter: grayscale(0.1) contrast(1.1). Consider adding very slight rotation jitter: rotate from -0.5deg to 0 for organic stamp imperfection.

prompts.prompt: Design a slice-wipe reveal where the word appears through horizontal slices that offset in from alternating directions on the downbeat. Think of it like a venetian blind transition in video editing, but faster and more aggressive. Divide the word into 4-5 horizontal slices, odd slices slide in from left, even from right, all converging simultaneously. Add a brief motion blur effect on each slice during movement, clearing to sharp focus when settled. Include subtle opacity fade from 0.7 to 1 during the slide to add depth. This recreates advanced masking transitions used in kinetic typography.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create wrapper with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing 5 BaseLayout slices using clip-path for horizontal divisions. Each slice: 'absolute w-full' with calculated clip-path: polygon(0 ${i*20}%, 100% ${i*20}%, 100% ${(i+1)*20}%, 0 ${(i+1)*20}%). Odd slices start at translateX(-100%), even slices at translateX(100%), all animate to translateX(0) over 0.2s with ease-out. Apply motion blur using filter: blur(3px) during translation, clearing to blur(0) on settle. Each slice contains the same TextAtom (duplicated) with 'font-bold text-6xl'. Add opacity animation from 0.7 to 1 synchronized with movement. Stagger timing slightly (delay: index * 0.02s) for fluid motion. Use transform-gpu and will-change-transform. Consider adding brief scale overrun: 1.02 to 1 at end of animation.

prompts.prompt: Build a liquid-morph preset where the word appears as if emerging from liquid on the downbeat. Start with the text heavily distorted using wave-like transforms, then quickly settle into readable form. Add a ripple effect that emanates from the center of the word outward. Include reflective highlights that shimmer across the text surface during formation. This simulates fluid dynamics effects commonly used in high-end motion graphics, like RealFlow or X-Particles renders.
prompts.technicalSpecs: TextAtom with SVG filter for liquid distortion. Initial filter: custom feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap for warping, animating baseFrequency from 0.02 to 0 over 0.3s. Add CSS transforms: scaleY(1.2) skewX(5deg) transitioning to scale(1) skew(0) over 0.25s with ease-out. Ripple effect using radial gradient mask animation or multiple concentric ring divs with 'rounded-full border border-current/20' expanding from center with decreasing opacity. Highlight shimmer using linear gradient overlay: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/30 to-transparent' with translateX animation from -100% to 200% over 0.4s. Use 'font-medium' with slightly rounded font for liquid feel. Container needs 'relative overflow-visible' for effects that extend beyond text bounds. Add subtle color shift using filter: hue-rotate animation from -10deg to 0.

prompts.prompt: Create a bass-drop explosion preset where the word appears with an aggressive radial burst effect on the downbeat. The word scales up from 0 to 1.1 to 1 (overshoot and settle) while simultaneously sending out shockwave rings and light rays. Add screen shake to the entire composition for the first 100ms. Include a brief white-out flash that covers the screen for just 1-2 frames at impact. The word should have an intense glow that pulses once then fades to normal. This recreates the impact effects used in music video drops and action scene transitions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: TextAtom starting at scale(0), animating to scale(1.1) at 0.1s, then scale(1) at 0.2s with spring easing. Shockwave using 3 absolute divs with 'rounded-full border-2 border-white/40', each starting at scale(0) and animating to scale(4) with opacity 0.5 to 0 over 0.5s, staggered by 0.05s. Light rays using 8 divs with 'absolute h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/30 to-transparent' rotated at 45deg intervals, scaling from scaleX(0) to scaleX(20) over 0.3s. Screen shake on container: translateX/Y with random values between -5 and 5px over 0.1s. White flash overlay: 'fixed inset-0 bg-white pointer-events-none' with opacity 1 to 0 over 0.05s. Glow using animating text-shadow: from '0 0 50px currentColor' to '0 0 10px currentColor' over 0.3s. Use 'font-black text-7xl uppercase' for maximum impact.
